capabilities: Count down to the nearest TaskNotes deadline with steps and hours left
Compute required daily pace and latest start days for subtasks
List steps you are waiting on others for with days waited
Provide a Countdown view for Bases plus sidebar, status bar and daily note blocks
Share the next deadline as a themed image card
disambiguation: Not a simple countdown timer; it plans work per deadline, computing pace, start days and waiting items from TaskNotes subtasks.
extras: Marked in the manifest as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free, makes no network requests, and writes files only on request (Countdown.base, share images). Docs and changelog live in the repository.
intentEvidence: The sidebar, status bar, note blocks and plans use the TaskNotes runtime API (apiVersion 1)
problem: TaskNotes shows due dates but not how much work remains, whether the pace to the deadline is feasible, or when each step should start.

relations.evidence: The sidebar, status bar, note blocks and plans use the TaskNotes runtime API (apiVersion 1)

summary: Deadline countdown for TaskNotes tasks that shows remaining steps, required daily pace, latest start days, and items you are waiting on.
